name: s7-s8-preregistration
title: Lightweight preregistration of the S7-S8 generation, grounding, abstention and citation evaluation, pinned by the hash of a private document
document_status: private; kept outside the public repository
scope: one local 4-bit generator, four contexts, the DEV split of 6 prompt-development and 18 evaluation needs, 15 negative contexts, a deterministic citation-integrity verifier, two deciding abstention rules (SELF and COMBINED), a cascade rule and two small human checks; the prompt is frozen at the hash below; no TEST v2, no LLM judge
amendments: append-only: a later version is a new document with a new hash, published before it is used
note: The commit that adds this file is the public timestamp: the prompt, the verifier, the cases and the rules were fixed before any evaluation output was generated.
